notes: §1985:XIII.3.15.2 prints 'LINE NUMBER IS { integer-1 [ ON NEXT PAGE ] | PLUS integer-2 }': the NEXT PAGE phrase exists only after integer-1, presenting the group 'beginning on the indicated line number on a new page' (§1985:XIII.3.15.4 GR5). The superset reportLineOperand also admits the 2023 alternative '[ON] NEXT PAGE' with no integer, and VersionConformancePass.VisitReportLineClause gates at 85 only a second operand and the LINES/NUMBERS/ARE spellings (COBOL0900, ReportMultiLine2002), VisitReportRelativeSign the '+' symbol: no 85 arm refuses the integer-less NEXT PAGE operand, so 'LINE NEXT PAGE' and 'LINE ON NEXT PAGE' compile and run at 85. Every other arm conforms: probes at 85 accepted LINE NUMBER IS 3 / LINE 3 / LINE IS 3 / LINE NUMBER 3 / LINE 3 [ON] NEXT PAGE (HELLO at line 3 of each page, form feed between), LINE PLUS 2, LINE PLUS 0 (same line, 'HELLO WORLD'); refused LINES 3, LINE NUMBERS 3, LINES ARE 3, LINE ARE 3, LINE 1 2, LINE PLUS 1 ON NEXT PAGE (the witness) with COBOL0900, LINE + 1 COBOL0900, LINE 0 COBOL2386, LINE WS-C COBOL1547, empty LINE / LINE -1 / LINE PLUS -1 COBOL0001, LINE written twice COBOL2423, an absolute LINE in an RD without PAGE COBOL2199. kb/Work PB5242 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-49.json).

next.reason: 1985: "LINE NUMBER IS { integer-1 [ ON NEXT PAGE ] | PLUS integer-2 }"; 2023: "{LINE NUMBER IS|LINE NUMBERS ARE|LINES ARE} {integer-1 [ON NEXT PAGE]|{PLUS|+} integer-2|ON NEXT PAGE} …". 2023 still accepts the 1985 forms but adds LINES/NUMBERS ARE, the + synonym, ON NEXT PAGE alone and repeated operands, so it accepts programs 1985 refuses.
